label: Networking
description: Windows networking infrastructure including DNS Server/Client, DHCP Server/Client, TCP/IP stack, SMB file sharing, DFS Namespaces and Replication, NPS (RADIUS) for 802.1x authentication, Wired and Wireless 802.1x, and VPN (SSTP, IKEv2, L2TP, Always On VPN)

technologies.label: DNS Server
technologies.description: Windows Server DNS Server role with AD integration, DNSSEC, DNS policies, and zone management

technologies.label: DNS Client
technologies.description: Windows DNS Client resolver with caching, NRPT policies, DNS over HTTPS, and multi-homed name resolution

technologies.label: DHCP Server
technologies.description: Windows Server DHCP Server with failover, policies, scavenging, and DNS integration

technologies.label: DHCP Client
technologies.description: Windows DHCP Client for IPv4 and IPv6 lease management, including APIPA and lease renewal

technologies.label: TCP/IP
technologies.description: Windows TCP/IP stack, IPv4/IPv6 dual stack, routing, MTU/PMTUD, NIC offloads, and performance troubleshooting

technologies.label: SMB
technologies.description: SMB 2.x/3.x file sharing with signing, encryption, multichannel, and performance optimization

technologies.label: DFS
technologies.description: DFS Namespaces (DFSN) and DFS Replication (DFSR) for distributed file storage and SYSVOL replication

technologies.label: NPS (RADIUS)
technologies.description: Network Policy Server for RADIUS authentication, EAP-TLS, PEAP, and 802.1x policy enforcement

technologies.label: 802.1x Wired
technologies.description: Wired 802.1x authentication with EAP-TLS, PEAP, switch port security, and NPS integration

technologies.label: 802.1x Wireless
technologies.description: Wireless 802.1x authentication for WPA2/WPA3-Enterprise, WAP controller integration, and roaming optimization

technologies.label: VPN
technologies.description: Windows VPN including SSTP, IKEv2, L2TP/IPsec, and Always On VPN (AOVPN) with RRAS and NPS
